notes.title: Your journey to the Void is about to begin!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pgnWkoPPZ6Y;full][/previewyoutube]

-Discover the tragic story of Paul Kimbel,  a fantasy author trapped in a nightmarish realm between life and death , in which his stories and  real life collide.

-Build various teams, customize your party members, try combos and different strategies to defeat the various and unique enemies that you will meet in your journey.

-Solve puzzles, by deciphering pieces of lore, exploring the void's twisted world and collect powerful items and weapond that will help you in your quest.


-Don't forget to whishlist the game and follow its social media, to join us in the final countdown until the launch day. I am beyond excited and I can't wait to share my passion project with you!

See you at launch
Deadpixel

notes.title: Help us to make the Void a better place!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

     I am very excited to announe that the demo of "Second Chances" will go live on May 22! 
You will have the chance to play the first chapter of the game,  meet the main characters, and learn the basics about the game mechanics  and the story.
     But the void can be a better place with your help! Join the forum of the game , and give your feedback , suggestions and reports about  any bugs! You can also join the discord community, to also discuss about the game and learn more about the game and the developing proccess! 

You can join our discord community here:  https://discord.gg/GZgpqWhmqT
       

 Stay awesome and keep playing great games!
     - Deadpixel

notes.title: “Official Publisher Announcement”
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello gamers![/h1]

My name is Deadpixel and I am the solo dev behind Second Chances. My goal is not only to create a great gaming experience, but also share an intriguing story about guilt, redemption, and forgiveness.


Sharing your work with the world as a solo dev can be quite challenging. Thankfully, having a great publisher like indie.io really helps me with getting my game and vision out there!


For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.





Don't forget to wishlist the game and play the demo! You can also check our [url=https://discord.com/invite/xNz7aFVN]Discord[/url] community and our social channels to be notified of future announcements!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407990/Second_Chances/


You can also check out the other amazing indie games being published by indie.io here!
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio

See you inside the void!
-Deadpixel
